method: Playwright Chromium loads each staged platform build with that build directory as the static-server root (no repository public assets), waits for network idle plus 1200ms, checks HTTP status, canvas mount, loading completion, state bootstrap, console errors, and page errors.
limitations: This is a web-lite staging smoke test only; it does not prove official WeChat, Douyin, or TapTap SDK/policy compliance or publishability.
All adapters intentionally report sdk-unavailable until platform SDK wiring and credentials are supplied.
